item.description: The Church of Ireland Bishop of Clogher, and the Roman Catholic Bishop of Clogher have released their Christmas message for 2025. The Bishop and Reverand outlined that at this season of short hours of daylight, we can be easily overcome with the dark. item.title: Man arrested over serious assault in Fermanagh
item.description: Police in the north have made an arrest following a serious assault in Enniskillen. It happened just after midnight, on East Bridge Street, where a man was punched in the head. He was taken to hospital, where he’s being treated for serious but non-life-threatening injuries. item.title: New water feature planned for Carrickmacrosss
item.description: A local councillor has welcomed funding allocated to Carrickmacross under the nationwide Town and Village Renewal scheme. Funding of €500,000 was awarded towards streetscape and amenity enhancements to the main street, including the enhancement of lighting to historic landmark buildings and the provision of a public water feature at the Market Square. item.title: Gardaí to conduct checkpoints as part of Christmas road safety campaign
item.description: Gardaí will continue to have an increased presence on the roads today, as part of their Christmas safety campaign. They say the festive period is one of the most dangerous times of year for road users, with too many lives still being lost and serious injuries occurring in preventable collisions. Over three thousand checkpoints have been carried out so far this month, and hundreds of people have been arrested for drink or drug driving. item.title: Local service says instances of domestic abuse rise during Christmas
item.description: While we often picture Christmas as a time for laughter and special moments with family, the reality can be a lot different for those living with domestic abuse. That's according to Siobhan McKenna from the Tearmann Domestic Support Service for Cavan and Monaghan. Siobhan says instances of domestic abuse often rise during this time of year. item.title: Cavan vet warns pet owners to keep eye out on toxic foods this Christmas
item.description: Local pet owners should 'act swiftly' if an animal ingests Christmas treats over the festive period. Aoife Flanagan, a vet with the Cavan vet clinic says that there are a number of things this time of year that are toxic for animals. She says that if foods are not usually in a pet's diet they should not be given to them at Christmas or the New Year, as they could cause gastric issues.
